training.initialization: Selected actor mean inherited; fresh critic and optimizer; reduced exploration.

registered_stationary_criteria.note: Stationary XY and heading thresholds do not replace the established direction-specific locomotion criteria.

publication_scope: Selected measurements, bounded verification results and source hashes, with user-selected A/B14second3x3 comparisons and their GIF previews. No raw original recordings, weights or private photographs.
limitations: Four independent expert policies; no single nine-skill actor or switching validation.
One seed per independent condition; no multi-seed robustness or isolated causal guarantee.
Recorded motion metadata and source hashes checked; motion arrays not independently recalculated for this publication.
Exposure h is a simulated load-budget state, not measured temperature.
Source hashes identify private evidence; the public selection does not reproduce the complete experiment.
No new video or GIF, private images, raw measurements, model weights, logs, training implementation or connection information is included.
